contexts.text: External idolatry is tolerated in order to prevent the profanation of holy things.
Persuasions of this kind are never tolerated in the other life.
It shall be more tolerable (). (Under Sodom, see this reference.)
Endurance even to the consummation. Signified. (For) evil is endured by the Lord until it is consummated or fulfilled.
On coming into the other life... everyone is tolerated among the good, although he is evil.
Why they were tolerated until the day of the Last Judgment. Explained...
From the beginning to the end of the Church all are tolerated who have lived an external moral life...
There are many reasons why such... Heavens were tolerated. Explained, Signified. LJCont 10.
Thy labour and thine endurance () = their study and patience.
Thy faith and endurance () = the truth and the study to acquire and teach it.

Because thou hast kept the word of My endurance () = because they have fought against evils, and then rejected falsities. The word of endurance = the spiritual combat which is called temptation... (This) is called the word of the Lord's endurance or patience, because in temptations the Lord fights for man, and fights by means of truths from His own Word. ( = that they have lived according to the precepts of the Lord. AE 214.)

I have known thy works, and thy labour, and thine endurance = all things which they will, think, and do, thus all things of love and faith in the spiritual and in the natural man... Works = the things which are of the will and love; labour = the things which are of thought and faith; and endurance = the things which take place thence or which they do. AE 98. AE 98:end.
And thine endurance () = conjunction with the external, and combat then. Explained.
Endurance is sometimes mentioned in the Revelation, and when it is mentioned it = that which is applied to life.
So long as the Babylonians were tolerated under Heaven...
